overall: Retries failed uploads with exponential backoff instead of giving up on the first error. Flaky networks were failing whole batches, so `upload` now retries up to three times and surfaces the last error only after that.

files.summary: Adds the retry loop to `uploader.go` and makes the attempt count configurable, so callers on stable networks can opt out.

hunks.summary:
Adds a `maxRetries` field to `Uploader` with a default of 3.

Without a bound, a dead endpoint would be retried forever, so the limit is part of the fix and not just a tuning knob.

1. `upload` now wraps `send` in a loop that sleeps `base << attempt` between tries, so short blips recover quickly while long outages back off.
2. `isRetryable` treats timeouts and 5xx responses as retryable and everything else as final, so a bad request is not repeated three times.
3. `backoff` adds jitter so many clients do not retry in lockstep.

elements.name: upload
elements.summary: Runs `send` up to `maxRetries` times and returns the last error. This is the behavior change the PR is for.

elements.name: isRetryable
elements.summary: Decides which errors are worth retrying, so client mistakes fail fast.

elements.name: backoff
elements.summary: Computes the delay with jitter, so a fleet of clients does not hit the server together.
